instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Filter and sort pull request list correctly (open, non-draft, most recently updated)
criteria.description: Navigate to psf/requests PR list and attempt to constrain results to: Open PRs, excluding Draft PRs, sorted by most recently updated. Full credit if the agent uses GitHub UI controls and/or query syntax to achieve the intended list, OR if GitHub UI/unauthenticated limitations prevent perfect filtering/sorting and the agent clearly states the limitation and uses the closest available visible ordering/filtering (e.g., Open + Updated sorting, with an explicit check/statement about drafts). Partial credit if the agent inspects PRs from an unsorted/unfiltered list without explaining why. No credit if the agent clearly uses Closed PRs or includes Draft PRs without noting it when non-draft options were visible.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshots 1-3 relate to filtering/sorting. Latest is Screenshot 3, which shows the PR search query box set to `is:pr is:open sort:updated-desc`, confirming open PRs and sorted by most recently updated. No screenshot shows an explicit draft exclusion term (e.g., `draft:false`) or a UI control for excluding drafts; also no visible Draft badges in the shown rows.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Compared to the baseline, sorting is verifiably correct in the latest state via `sort:updated-desc`, even though an earlier screenshot showed the sort dropdown checkmark on “Newest.” However, the task required filtering to non-draft PRs; there is no evidence the agent applied a draft filter or verified draft status beyond absence of visible Draft badges. So this remains partial credit rather than full.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the GitHub PR list page for `psf/requests` with the `Pull requests` tab selected. The search query box contains: `is:pr is:open sort:updated-desc`. Above the list it shows `86 Open` and `2,974 Closed`. A link says `Clear current search query, filters, and sorts`. The PR list shows items like `requests.help static typing improvements` and several PRs labeled `mass-automation-pr`.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The visible query `is:pr is:open sort:updated-desc` confirms the list is filtered to open pull requests and sorted by most recently updated (updated-desc). However, the screenshot does not show any explicit exclusion of Draft PRs (no `draft:false` in the query, and no visible indication that drafts are filtered out). The list items shown do not display any obvious `Draft` badge in the visible rows, but absence of a badge in these few rows does not confirm a non-draft-only filter was applied.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Task requires filtering to open non-draft PRs. The screenshot shows open + updated-desc but does not show any draft exclusion syntax/control. No explicit evidence the agent filtered out drafts.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the GitHub PR list page for “psf / requests” with the “Pull requests” tab selected. A search/filter box contains the text “is:pr is:open”. Above the list it shows “86 Open” and “2,974 Closed”. A “Sort by” dropdown is open and the option “Newest” has a checkmark next to it (other options visible include “Oldest”, “Most commented”, “Least commented”, “Recently updated”, “Least recently updated”, “Best match”; “Most reactions” appears greyed out). There is no visible filter/control specifically excluding “Draft” PRs, and no “draft” text is visible in the query.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Open PRs are clearly selected/filtered (the query includes “is:open” and the page indicates “86 Open”). However, the list is not sorted by “most recently updated” in this screenshot; the sort dropdown indicates “Newest” is currently selected while “Recently updated” is merely an available option. Also, there is no visible evidence that draft PRs are excluded (no “draft:false” or similar, and no UI indication). This is at best partial progress toward the required filter/sort state.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The action history implies the agent set sorting to “Recently updated,” but the screenshot shows the sort checkmark on “Newest,” not “Recently updated.” No evidence in the screenshot that non-draft filtering was applied.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the GitHub PR list for repository “psf/requests” on the “Pull requests” tab. A search filter box contains the query text “is:pr is:open”. Above the list it shows “86 Open” and “2,974 Closed”. On the right side of the list header there is a “Sort” dropdown (label visible), but the screenshot does not show the dropdown opened nor the currently-selected sort option. No “Draft” indicators are visible on the listed PR rows in this screenshot. Several PR entries are visible with green labels “mass-automation-pr”, and one entry shows a gray label “Contributor” and another shows “Approved”.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Open PR filtering is clearly applied (query includes “is:open” and the page indicates “86 Open”). However, the screenshot does not provide evidence that Draft PRs are excluded (no explicit “draft:false” filter shown, and no visible check about draft status beyond not seeing any Draft badges in the visible rows). The screenshot also does not confirm that sorting is set to “most recently updated” because the “Sort” control is present but its selected value is not displayed. Overall: partial support for correct filtering (open PRs), but sorting and non-draft filtering are not verifiable from this screenshot alone.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Action history suggests the agent clicked to set sort order to “Recently updated,” but the screenshot does not show the selected sort value or an opened sort menu confirming that setting. The screenshot also does not show any explicit non-draft filter being applied beyond the absence of visible “Draft” badges.

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: Latest relevant DOM is State 2 (DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 2) showing URL query `.../pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+sort%3Aupdated-desc`, which explicitly confirms `is:pr`, `is:open`, and `sort:updated-desc` (most recently updated). Earlier states show the Sort menu and Open/Closed tabs, but no explicit draft/non-draft filter is shown in any DOM state.
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Upgrade from baseline 2 to 2.5 because the DOM explicitly verifies the open PR list is sorted by updated-desc via the URL query. Still not full credit because no DOM evidence shows filtering out drafts (e.g., `draft:false`) or confirms the first three results are non-draft.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 2 shows URL `https://github.com/psf/requests/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+sort%3Aupdated-desc`, which encodes filters `is:pr is:open sort:updated-desc` (open PRs, sorted by most recently updated). The page also shows `86 Open` (link) and a visible `Sort` control.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
The DOM proves the agent is viewing the Open PR list sorted by updated-desc (most recently updated) via the query string. However, there is no explicit DOM evidence that Draft PRs are excluded/filtered out, nor any evidence the agent checked for drafts in the first three results. Therefore, filtering/sorting is only partially verified against the full requirement (open, non-draft, recently updated).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Rubric requires excluding Draft PRs (or explicitly noting limitation/check). DOM shows open + updated-desc but does not show any draft-exclusion filter (e.g., `draft:false`) or an explicit draft check for the first three items.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 1 (https://github.com/psf/requests/pulls). The Sort menu is open and shows sort options including “Recently updated” ([11512]). The PR list shown includes items like “#7586 opened by Jul 18, 2026”, “#7579 opened by Jul 11, 2026”, etc. The page shows “86 Open” ([373]) and “2,974 Closed” ([376]) toggles, but no explicit DOM evidence of selecting the “Open” filter nor excluding “Draft” PRs. evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
The agent clearly attempted to sort via the Sort control and choose “Recently updated” per action history, and the DOM confirms the Sort UI is present with “Recently updated” as an option. However, this DOM snapshot does not confirm the selection was applied (it does not show the active sort or changed ordering), nor does it confirm drafts were excluded or checked. It also does not explicitly show that the list is filtered to Open beyond the presence of the “86 Open” tab.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Rubric requires open, non-draft, and sorted by most recently updated. DOM evidence does not verify: (a) the active sort is “Recently updated” (only that it exists in the menu), and (b) that Draft PRs were excluded/checked. Also, the visible list shows PRs with “opened by” dates, not “updated” timestamps, so correct ordering by updated cannot be verified from this snapshot.

The DOM snapshot confirms the agent was on the psf/requests pull request list page and that an Open PR list view and a Sort control exist (DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0: "86 Open", "2,974 Closed", and "Sort"). - No DOM snapshot after Action 2 to verify the active sort order is "Recently updated".
- No DOM evidence showing draft PRs are excluded or that the list contains only non-draft PRs (absence of any "Draft" indicators or filter state in provided DOM).

criteria.criterion: Inspect and report PR #1 details and file-change summary (as displayed by GitHub)
criteria.description: For the first (most recently updated) qualifying PR from the filtered/sorted list, report: number, title, author, last-updated date, labels (as shown), changed-file count, additions, deletions, and whether any test file is included in the Files changed tab (verified by viewing the file list). Full credit if all fields are reported exactly as GitHub displays, OR if the agent clearly attempts to open the PR and Files changed but GitHub does not display some fields (e.g., Files changed fails to load, rate-limited, partial file list) and the agent explicitly states which fields could not be verified and why. Partial credit if one or two fields are missing without explanation, or if test-file presence is stated without indicating the Files changed list was checked when it was accessible.

Even though screenshots would have supported some of those omitted metadata fields (number/title/author/labels), the last-updated date is not shown in the provided evidence and the agent did not report it or note it was unverified. Because multiple required fields are missing from the agent output, this remains 0 points.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows a GitHub PR page in the psf/requests repo on the “Files changed” tab for PR titled “requests.help static typing improvements #7506”. Near the top, it shows “Open” and the line “jorenham wants to merge 1 commit into psf:main from jorenham:typing/help/coverage”. Tabs visible include “Conversation”, “Commits 1”, “Checks 32”, and “Files changed 1” (selected). On the right of the Files changed header area, a green/red diffstat shows “+26 −19”. In the file list, one file path is visible: “src/requests/help.py”. Above the diff, a label shows “45” (total changes). No PR “last-updated date” field is visible in this screenshot. No labels/tags section is visible in this screenshot (other than the green “Open” state).
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Partial support only. The screenshot supports the agent’s reported changed-file count (Files changed shows 1; one file “src/requests/help.py” is listed) and additions/deletions (+26/−19 visible). It also supports that the Files changed list was viewed, enabling a check for whether a test file is included; only “src/requests/help.py” is visible, which is not a typical test path. However, the criterion requires additionally reporting author, last-updated date, and labels “as displayed by GitHub.” The screenshot does show the author/actor line (“jorenham wants to merge…”) but does not show any last-updated date or any labels list, so those parts cannot be verified from this image and were not included in the agent’s predicted output.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent predicted output states: “From the Files changed tab for PR #7506…” and reports 1 file, +26/−19, and no test file. These match what is visible (+26 −19; Files changed 1; file path “src/requests/help.py”). The agent did not report PR number/title/author/last-updated date/labels as required by the task/criterion; the screenshot shows the title and PR number (#7506) and the author name “jorenham,” but the agent output only covered file-change details.
